name: Project Context shows the not-cloned state on the seeded repo
description: The seeded acme/payments-api has a null clone_path (see e2e/.context/docs/seed-contract.md), so no document can be listed in a browser flow; the populated path is covered by the server and component suites. This flow asserts the not-cloned state on both surfaces: the sidebar's Project Context entry opens the page, which says the repository is not cloned (AC-12, AC-20); and the seeded Security Reviewer's editor shows a Context tab after Skills whose body says the same (AC-21, AC-40). The editor renders a Skeleton until its TanStack Query resolves, so `wait --load networkidle` precedes the tab click. Read-only seeded data, no model call. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (use the hermetic runner).

steps.label: load the app; home redirects to the first repo
open Project Context from the sidebar
agent detail settles — the editor is a Skeleton until its query resolves
context tab is active in the URL
